title: The red ring
purpose: Teach what a total lunar eclipse looks like from the Moon, why Earth wears a red ring, and what it does to solar power.

beats.label: measured
beats.sub: Aurora's exact start and end depend on its site and horizon

captions: On {day}, the Sun, Earth and Moon line up.
The Moon slides into Earth's shadow: a total lunar eclipse.
From the Moon, Earth covers the whole Sun.
Sunlight bending through Earth's air paints a thin red ring around it.
The full shadow lasts about {total} minutes.
Those minutes are for the whole Moon.
ends_on: While Earth hides the Sun, the panels make almost nothing. Plan the battery for the dark.
